[[Orn Free Taa/Legends|Orn Free Taa's]] '''Twi'lek aide''' was a [[Lethan/Legends|Lethan]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] who served him in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]]. Her wardrobe included a metallic, patterned dress, a dark blue cloak and a silver headpiece.

==Biography==
[[File:OrnFreeTaaAide-SWCTP.png|thumb|left|180px|The aide close by Taa's side]]
This Lethan Twi'lek served [[Orn Free Taa/Legends|Orn Free Taa]] along with [[Pampy/Legends|Pampy]] prior to the events of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. It was said that she often flirted with Orn Free Taa due to his vast wealth. In [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], she was present with Taa when [[Monarch of Naboo/Legends|Queen]] Amidala came to the Senate to ask for help after [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] was invaded by the [[Trade Federation]]. However, [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Chancellor]] [[Finis Valorum]] refused. Then, senators including Taa [[Vote of No Confidence/Legends|voted]] Valorum out of office. Some time later, she was replaced by [[Supi/Legends|Supi]].
